''See also: [[Akura Grace Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|[[Akura clan|Akura]] Grace is a skilled [[Underlord]] and a member of the [[Akura clan]]. A descendant of [[Malice]], she is described as a beautiful woman with long dark hair and purple eyes, bearing a strong resemblance to the [[Monarch]]. Though she did not bond with any of the [[Books of Seven Pages]], she possesses significant combat expertise in her [[shadow Path]] and is a master with her long, curved saber. Grace served as the leader of the [[Akura backup team]] during a [[tournament]], where she maintained a competitive standing despite her team being assembled at the last minute to replace a destroyed group. During these events, she demonstrated high-level combat prowess and elegance in movement. She is the daughter of [[Akura Earnest]] and Kiya, and was considered a rising talent within her family. In later conflicts, Grace was part of a group that faced significant casualties; she was killed during an encounter with a team of [[dragons]], an event witnessed by [[Akura Mercy]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|[[Akura clan|Akura]] Grace is a young warrior who wears a cloth wrapped around her missing eye. She utilizes a long, single-edged [[steel]] saber that is lightly curved and retrieved from her [[soulspace]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|She is a cousin to both [[Akura Douji|Douji]] and [[Akura Courage|Courage]]. Additionally, she was a former member of [[Lindon]]'s team.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|She has mastered the [[shadow Path]] and her [[sword]] skills. Her powers include the use of a [[void key]] and bodies remade in [[soulfire]].}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Akura Clan Underlord}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|As a young [[Underlord]] within the [[Akura clan]], [[Akura clan|Akura]] Grace serves as an [[Underlord]] candidate for the [[Akura prime team|Akura team]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c7">''Uncrowned'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c8">''Uncrowned'', chapter 8</ref> She has achieved mastery over both her [[shadow Path]] and her [[sword]], utilizing a lightly curved saber as her weapon.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c7" /> Her bodies are remade in [[soulfire]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c7" /> While she leads the [[Akura backup team]], she was ultimately eliminated during the second round.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c10">''Uncrowned'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c15">''Uncrowned'', chapter 15</ref>}}
